detailed_descriptions.en: Play as Kunugi, a homeless girl trying to survive while exacting revenge on the bully who ruined her life. Just when she’s about to get back at him, a mysterious White Door appears out of thin air. Desperate to get away from her, the bully goes inside the door. As she’s about to follow him, a mysterious girl appears out of nowhere and tries to stop her. Kunugi ignores her and enters the White Door to chase her target. What awaits her inside is a bizarre, lawless space where humans can acquire power. Will she be able to exact her revenge? What exactly are the White Doors? Find out by playing the game! "Kunugi’s Life Is a Mess!" is a roguelike, turn-based dungeon-crawling RPG. It features core turn-based gameplay with a big emphasis on strategy, allowing you to choose which skills to learn, which items to use, and what equipment to equip before entering the dungeon. Each run resets your level back to 1, and your goal is to progress through the dungeon and grow as strong as possible before facing the boss. Flashback Relive Kunugi's memories after encountered events. Dialogue Options Depending on your choice, you’ll receive a buff or debuff, new item, or maybe even a level-up! Everything is possible within the dungeon. Rerun the Dungeon If you need more resources to progress, you can rerun a dungeon to earn more money! Challenge After the initial dungeon run, a remnant of the boss can be battled for a more challenging run.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Play as Kunugi, a homeless girl trying to survive while exacting revenge on the bully who ruined her life.

Just when she’s about to get back at him, a mysterious White Door appears out of thin air. Desperate to get away from her, the bully goes inside the door. As she’s about to follow him, a mysterious girl appears out of nowhere and tries to stop her. Kunugi ignores her and enters the White Door to chase her target.

What awaits her inside is a bizarre, lawless space where humans can acquire power. Will she be able to exact her revenge? What exactly are the White Doors? Find out by playing the game!

"Kunugi’s Life Is a Mess!" is a roguelike, turn-based dungeon-crawling RPG.

It features core turn-based gameplay with a big emphasis on strategy, allowing you to choose which skills to learn, which items to use, and what equipment to equip before entering the dungeon.

Each run resets your level back to 1, and your goal is to progress through the dungeon and grow as strong as possible before facing the boss.

Flashback

Relive Kunugi's memories after encountered events.

Dialogue Options

Depending on your choice, you’ll receive a buff or debuff, new item, or maybe even a level-up! Everything is possible within the dungeon.

Rerun the Dungeon

If you need more resources to progress, you can rerun a dungeon to earn more money!

Challenge

After the initial dungeon run, a remnant of the boss can be battled for a more challenging run.
